name: 03_set_template_props
task: In 1C Configurator a new URL template 'ШаблонURL1' was just created (its name field may currently be empty) in HTTP service 'api_http' of the extension 'api', and its properties window 'Свойства: ШаблонURL1' is open. Set its name to api_test3p and its template string to /test3p. Do not save the configuration.
rules: Work only in the properties window of the NEW URL template and in the right 'api' tree. Never rename or change demo_status, GET or other existing objects. Do not delete anything. Never press Ctrl+S or F7.

subgoals.goal: In the properties window 'Свойства: ШаблонURL1', set the field 'Имя' (it may be empty now) to api_test3p using the set_field action on the value cell to the right of the label 'Имя'.
subgoals.check: A properties window of a URL template shows the name api_test3p (in its title or in the 'Имя' field), or the right tree contains a node api_test3p.

subgoals.goal: In the same properties window (now for api_test3p), set the field 'Шаблон' to /test3p using the set_field action on the value cell to the right of the label 'Шаблон'.
subgoals.check: In the properties window of api_test3p the field 'Шаблон' contains /test3p.
